ch0346_00_kihada/0101_0701_01_10:
Osu! [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Are you training with gusto?
ch0346_00_kihada/0101_0701_02_10:
Why don’t we spend today running together
to get to know each other a little better?
ch0346_00_kihada/7101_0701_01_10:
Being full of energy is what I’m cut out for!
I can confidently say that!
ch0346_00_kihada/7101_0701_02_10:
You’ve got as much spirit as I do!
That’s great!
ch0346_00_kihada/7101_0701_03_10:
As long as I have this extra energy, I can
take on anything!
ch0346_00_kihada/7102_0701_01_10:
Back at the academy in Paldea, I held all my
battle studies classes in the schoolyard—
even for book learning!
ch0346_00_kihada/7102_0701_02_10:
I’ll hold classes outside whenever I teach on
Pasio, too!
ch0346_00_kihada/7103_0701_01_10:
Everyone has things they’re cut out for and
things they’re not!
ch0346_00_kihada/7103_0701_02_10:
It’s important to overcome your weaknesses,
but it’s better to understand what you’re
good at and focus on that instead!
ch0346_00_kihada/7103_0701_03_10:
Make your strong points stronger, I always
say—that goes for both people and
Pokémon!
ch0346_00_kihada/7104_0701_01_10: You know, I’m also a fitness instructor.
ch0346_00_kihada/7104_0701_02_10:
Let me know if you ever want to train up
your mind and body!
ch0346_00_kihada/7104_0701_03_10:
If you want, I’ve got some intense exercises
I could put you through!
ch0346_00_kihada/7105_0701_01_10:
In my battle studies, no Trainer gets left in
the dust!
ch0346_00_kihada/7105_0701_02_10:
How are your Pokémon battles going,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]?
ch0346_00_kihada/7105_0701_03_10: If you ever feel lost, you can come to me!
ch0346_00_kihada/1701_0702_01_10:
Learn lots and keep that body moving!
Good luck! Osu!
ch0346_00_kihada/2501_0701_01_10:
For battle and play, a healthy body is best!
Are you keeping yourself moving?
ch0346_00_kihada/2501_0701_02_10:
If you’re unsure, allow me to teach you
about strength training!
ch0346_00_kihada/2501_0702_01_10:
Without strength, you’ll miss out on exploring
all kinds of places!
ch0346_00_kihada/2501_0702_02_10:
Borrowing power from Pokémon is important,
but in the end, you can only rely on your
own body!
ch0346_00_kihada/2511_0701_01_10:
To tell you the truth, I don’t know the first
thing about making good food...
ch0346_00_kihada/2511_0701_02_10:
But I do practice my cooking to share with
Nurse Miriam, since she’s always taking care
of me!
ch0346_00_kihada/2511_0701_03_10:
The practice is worth it! I’ve improved,
even if only a little!
ch0346_00_kihada/2511_0702_02_10:
Well... If it’s for you, I guess I can give it
another try!
ch0346_00_kihada/3001_0701_01_10:
Morning! Have your Pokémon chug some
protein so they can smash through their
limits! Osu!
ch0346_00_kihada/3003_0701_01_10:
A good bout of training sure does make a
body hungry, doesn’t it?
ch0346_00_kihada/3005_0701_01_10:
If you’re frustrated or down, look out on the
ocean and soak in those feelings! You’ll feel
better the next day! Osu!
